summary: AXT Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a long-term supply agreement (June 11, 2026) between its subsidiary Beijing Tongmei Xtal Technology Co., Ltd. and Nanjing Casela Technologies Corporation Ltd. The non-binding summary discloses Casela's commitment to purchase a fixed aggregate quantity of indium phosphide wafer substrates in 2027 for approximately RMB 173 million (US$25.4 million), with 50% prepayment due within 15 business days and the remainder by end of 2026, plus a cancellation fee if purchases fall below 80%. This is a routine commercial supply contract with prepayment and termination provisions. No special-situation category applies; the filing is a standard current report on a material definitive agreement.
